Message:
Lighting a 9,000 sq.ft oceanfront residence demands absolute restraint. Any exposed ceiling glare immediately reflects off floor-to-ceiling coastal glass and ruins the night horizon.

For Azure — The Oceanic in Chennai (Architecture by WOW Architects, Singapore), LITELAB engineered a three-tier architectural illumination system:

1. Concealed Perimeter Slots: 2700K indirect coves float the warm timber ceilings without visible hardware.
2. Deep-Recessed Anti-Glare Optics (UGR < 16, CRI 97+): Precision 15° pinholes graze stone walls and private art while keeping glass reflections crystal clear.
3. Seamless Terrace & Pool Integration: Marine-grade 2700K step and deck luminaires extend the living room's visual depth out to the coastline.
